Initial release of smyx-cutting-rooting-status-detection-analysis.

- Provides AI-powered, non-invasive detection of plant cutting rooting stages in transparent containers.
- Automatically analyzes images or videos of the cutting base to identify and count white root primordia, outputting stages: No Roots / Few Primordia / Many Primordia / Well-Developed Roots.
- Supports history tracking and querying of rooting analysis reports via a cloud API, with strict open-id authentication rules.
- Offers clear user guidance for image requirements, report querying, and mandatory open-id retrieval before any analysis.
- Outputs structured results and root analysis reports in Markdown table format for easy review and tracking.
